controls: same saved weights; frozen evidence weights; shared learned motor; evidence-selection comparison, not whole-system core-disabled

encoder.prior: contrastive sentence training includes QA and code pairs; contamination unknown
encoder.sentence_pooling: attention-mask mean including special tokens; L2 normalization
encoder.span_pooling: mean overlapping complete non-special subtokens; no normalization
encoder.truncation: reject; caller must declare any chunking

exposure: reconstructed original documents, receipt lineage and motor prior; no evidence updates, receipt replay updates or new teacher executions
kind: saved exploration checkpoints; affine readout recovery; no evidence learning
resource_scope: parent/evaluator memory excludes child memory; wall time includes child waits

synapse_checkpoint.scope: trained synapses; ordered fixtures and receipts reconstruct storage and lineage
